## 112. M3-T11-101 — interior selector globalizes to the symmetric-product quadratic squareclass; fixed-Pi fiber is smooth genus 5
Status: PROVISIONAL EXACT_GLOBAL_SQUARECLASS / INTERIOR_SPLITTING_RECEIVER / FIXED_PI_GENUS5 / RECIPROCITY_ONLY_NO_GO / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / NO POWER SAVING.
Retain hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-099/100 together with Sections 35, 48, and 49. Work on the exact fixed-content/coefficient nondegenerate physical endpoint population with R<=B.


### 112.1 One global integer absorbs every interior local auxiliary unit
Write
M=M_rel,
S=s/t,
u=a/b,
N_u=a^2+b^2.
For every fresh p^lambda||M, M3-T11-040 gives
k_p=v_p(t)=2*lambda-c_p,
and
min(4*lambda,v_p(N_u))=2*lambda+c_p.
If c_p<2*lambda, then v_p(N_u)=2*lambda+c_p exactly, hence
v_p(t*N_u)=4*lambda.
If c_p=2*lambda, then v_p(t)=0 and v_p(N_u)>=4*lambda.
Therefore, globally,
boxed:
M^4 | t*N_u.
Define the integer
boxed:
J=t*N_u/M^4.


Now fix an interior fresh prime p^lambda||M, so 0<c_p<2*lambda. Write
t=p^k_p*tau_p,
N_u=p^(2*lambda+c_p)*nu_p,
M=p^lambda*M_p,
with p not dividing tau_p*nu_p*M_p.
Then exactly
boxed:
J=tau_p*nu_p/M_p^4.
In particular J is a p-adic unit and
boxed:
chi_p(J)=chi_p(tau_p*nu_p).


### 112.2 The M3-T11-099 selector is one global quadratic splitting condition
At a fresh Gaussian prime, choose rho with
a==rho*b mod p,
rho^2==-1 mod p.
Because p==1 mod 4, changing rho to -rho does not change its quadratic character, and
chi_p(rho)=rho^((p-1)/2)
=(-1)^((p-1)/4)
=(2/p).


Audited M3-T11-099 gives the exact interior selector
chi_p(s)=chi_p(rho*tau_p*nu_p).
Using the global J above,
boxed:
chi_p(s*J)=chi_p(rho)=(2/p),
hence
boxed:
chi_p(2*s*J)=+1.


Define
boxed:
A_int=2*s*J=2*s*t*N_u/M^4.
For every interior p, p does not divide A_int and
boxed:
(A_int/p)=+1.
Thus the entire interior-prime system is the splitting condition for one global rational squareclass, rather than a collection of genuinely independent p-dependent auxiliary signs.


### 112.3 The global squareclass is exactly the old symmetric product 2*Pi
Section 35/49 gives the exact symmetric product
Pi=v_1*v_2*v_3
=4*u^2*S/(1+u^2)
=4*a^2*s/(t*N_u).
Therefore
boxed:
(s*J)*Pi
=
(s*t*N_u/M^4)*(4*a^2*s/(t*N_u))
=
(2*a*s/M^2)^2.
Hence in Q*/Q*^2,
boxed:
[s*J]=[Pi],
and consequently
boxed:
[A_int]=[2*Pi].


Equivalently, for every interior p^lambda||M,
boxed:
chi_p(2*p^(4*lambda)*Pi)=+1.
Section 49 gives v_p(Den(Pi))=4*lambda exactly on every fresh p, so the forced fresh denominator contribution is a fourth power and disappears from the quadratic squareclass. Thus p is unramified in the quadratic algebra attached to [2*Pi], and the interior selector says that p has trivial local quadratic character there; when [2*Pi] is nontrivial, p splits in
K_Pi=Q(sqrt(2*Pi)).


This is the exact global cross-prime receiver:
boxed:
every interior conductor prime splits in K_Pi.


The conductor itself is NOT recovered as ramification of K_Pi; its forced fourth-power denominator is invisible to the squareclass.


### 112.4 Reciprocity-only firewall
This globalization is not a fixed-power saving.
For a fixed quadratic squareclass, one splitting sign per distinct interior prime still has the selector-only scale 2^(-omega(q_int)); in particular a prime q_int gives only 1/2. Taking products of the local symbols, applying Jacobi-symbol identities, or invoking quadratic reciprocity without additional endpoint-incidence information only repackages the same accepted sign vector and does not turn it into q_int^(-delta).


Therefore the legal continuation is not another isolated character-sum or reciprocity loop. A successful theorem must couple the realized moving squareclass [2*Pi] with the physical endpoint geometry/support, or introduce genuinely new global information not determined by the audited local square equation.


### 112.5 Fixed-Pi physical fiber is a smooth genus-5 hyperelliptic curve
There is nevertheless a concrete same-measure geometric receiver for the moving squareclass.
Fix a rational value
Pi=pi!=0.
From
Pi=4*u^2*S/(1+u^2),
one has
S=pi*(1+u^2)/(4*u^2).
Substitute this into the audited Section-35 split-cubic discriminant equation
Y^2=-(1+u^2)*Q(S,u)
and set
Z=16*u^4*Y.
Then exactly
boxed:
Z^2=-(1+u^2)*G_pi(u),
where
G_pi(u)
=
pi^4*(1+u^2)^5
-64*pi^3*u^3*(1+u^2)^3
+64*pi^2*u^4*(1+u^2)^2*(11*u^2-1)
+3072*pi*u^7*(1+u^2)
-4096*u^10.


The degree-12 leading coefficient is
4096-704*pi^2-pi^4.
It cannot vanish for rational pi, because pi^2 would have to equal -352+160*sqrt(5) or -352-160*sqrt(5).


Exact discriminant calculation gives
boxed:
Disc_u(-(1+u^2)*G_pi(u))
=
2^156*pi^32*(729*pi^2-512)^3*(256*pi^4+96417*pi^2-746496).


For rational pi!=0 none of the displayed factors vanishes:
729*pi^2=512 would give pi=+/-16*sqrt(2)/27;
and, putting z=pi^2,
256*z^2+96417*z-746496=0
has roots
(-96417+/-24327*sqrt(17))/512,
which are irrational.
Hence every nonzero rational fixed-Pi fiber is squarefree of degree 12 and therefore is a smooth hyperelliptic curve of genus 5.


The nondegenerate physical branch has Pi!=0 because all three anti-roots are nonzero.


### 112.6 Route consequence

No uniform B^o(1) bound for fixed Pi is proved, and qualitative finiteness of rational points on one fixed genus-5 curve may not be promoted to a uniform same-measure counting theorem.


No fixed-power saving, denominator-extreme closure, primary-gate closure, endpoint theorem, P(B)/M3(B) limit, or Perfect Cuboid nonexistence credit is obtained.

## 114. M3-T11-102 — fixed [2*Pi] is a squareclass surface with smooth genus-3 q-fibers, not the fixed-Pi genus-5 curve
Status: PROVISIONAL EXACT_SQUARECLASS_GEOMETRY / FIXED_SQUARECLASS_SURFACE / GENUS3_DOUBLE_COVER / FIXED_PI_OVERREFINEMENT_FIREWALL / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / NO POWER SAVING.

### 114.1 Three exact representatives of the receiver squareclass

boxed:

boxed:

in Q*/Q*^2.

boxed:

and hence
boxed:

On the nonzero split-discriminant locus Q(S,u)!=0, the endpoint equation
Y^2=-(1+u^2)*Q(S,u)
also gives
boxed:

Thus the M3-T11-101 quadratic receiver can be read directly from the symmetric surface without the p-dependent auxiliary units.


### 114.2 Canonical squareclass representative and exact fresh denominator of its square root

### 114.3 Fixing the splitting field does not fix Pi
The interior splitting condition of M3-T11-101 depends only on d=[2*Pi], not on the exact value of Pi.

Consequently, fixed-Pi genus-5 finiteness or any future fixed-Pi multiplicity bound cannot be charged as a fixed-squareclass theorem unless the realized q / exact-Pi support inside one d is also controlled on the same physical measure.

Therefore every rational fixed-(d,u) physical fiber is a smooth degree-8 hyperelliptic curve of genus 3.


### 114.5 The genus-3 fiber is a quadratic cover of the old fixed-u genus-one fiber
The equation is even in q. Quotient by the involution q->-q and put z=q^2. The quotient is a smooth quartic genus-one curve. After the linear change x=d*z=2*Pi and

The audited fixed-u B^o(1) theorem still implies fixed (d,u) physical multiplicity is at most B^o(1), but fixing d alone leaves u and q moving on a surface.


### 114.6 Route consequence and firewall
M3-T11-102 refines the M3-T11-101 receiver:

No fixed-power saving, denominator-extreme closure, primary-gate closure, endpoint theorem, P(B)/M3(B) limit, or Perfect Cuboid nonexistence credit is obtained.

## 116. M3-T11-103 — complementary genus-2 quadratic-twist quotient of the fixed-squareclass genus-3 cover


Status: PROVISIONAL EXACT_V4_DECOMPOSITION / GENUS2_QUADRATIC_TWIST_RECEIVER / RECIPROCAL_SPLIT_NO_GO / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / NO POWER SAVING.


Retain hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-102 and its exact fixed-squareclass cover. Work on the same fixed-content/coefficient nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoint population with R<=B.


### 116.1 Rewrite the genus-3 cover through x=d*q^2


Put
A=1+u^2
and
x=d*q^2.
Define
H_u(x)
=
A^5*x^4
-128*u^3*A^3*x^3
+256*u^4*A^2*(11*u^2-1)*x^2
+24576*u^7*A*x
-65536*u^10.


Then the audited M3-T11-102 equation is exactly
T^2=-A*H_u(d*q^2).


Thus the squareclass parameter d does not enter the quartic H_u itself; it enters through the square-coordinate x=d*q^2.


The involution
sigma:(q,T)->(-q,T)
has the already-audited genus-one quotient in x=d*q^2. This factor is old and receives no new credit.


### 116.2 The complementary involution gives a genus-2 d-twist


Let
iota:(q,T)->(q,-T)
be the hyperelliptic involution and
tau=sigma*iota:(q,T)->(-q,-T).


Two tau-invariants are
x=d*q^2,
W=d*q*T.


Direct substitution gives
boxed:
W^2=-d*A*x*H_u(x).


Hence the tau quotient is
boxed:
H_{d,u}: W^2=-d*(1+u^2)*x*H_u(x).


For fixed u, this is exactly the quadratic twist by d of the base genus-2 curve
H_{1,u}: W^2=-(1+u^2)*x*H_u(x).


The exact quartic and quintic discriminants are
boxed:
Disc_x(H_u)
=
-2^52*u^26*(1+u^2)^14*(25*u^2-2)^3,


boxed:
Disc_x(-(1+u^2)*x*H_u(x))
=
-2^84*u^46*(1+u^2)^22*(25*u^2-2)^3.


Therefore
Disc_x(-d*(1+u^2)*x*H_u(x))
=
-2^84*d^8*u^46*(1+u^2)^22*(25*u^2-2)^3.


For rational physical d!=0 and u!=0 this is nonzero, because u^2=2/25 has no rational solution. Thus every fixed-(d,u) complementary quotient is a smooth genus-2 curve.


The points x=0 and infinity are rational Weierstrass points, so Jac(H_{d,u})(Q) contains the rational 2-torsion class [(0,0)-infinity]. This is a descent interface only; it is not a saving by itself.


### 116.3 V4 Jacobian decomposition isolates the genuinely new factor


The involutions sigma and iota commute, and the full V4 quotient is genus zero. Applying the standard V4 idempotent/Kani-Rosen decomposition to this exact Q-defined action gives, up to Q-isogeny,
boxed:
Jac(C_{d,u}) ~_Q E_u x Jac(H_{d,u}),
where C_{d,u} is the M3-T11-102 genus-3 cover and E_u is its sigma quotient, namely the already-audited Section-35 fixed-u genus-one incidence.


Consequently, after the old elliptic factor is firewalled against double charging, the only new Jacobian arithmetic exposed by the fixed-squareclass cover is the genus-2 quadratic-twist factor H_{d,u}.


This sharpens the live receiver from a generic genus-3 moving-cover problem to a concrete genus-2 twist/Selmer-support problem, while preserving the exact same physical measure.


### 116.4 Reciprocal second-elliptic split is uniformly absent


Write the quartic H_u(x) as
a*x^4+b*x^3+c*x^2+e1*x+f,
with
a=A^5,
b=-128*u^3*A^3,
e1=24576*u^7*A,
f=-65536*u^10.


The same reciprocal branch-set criterion used in audited M3-T11-044 says that a Q-rational commuting involution of reciprocal form x->lambda/x, which would split the genus-2 factor by this mechanism, requires
f*b^2-a*e1^2=0.


Exact factorization gives
boxed:
f*b^2-a*e1^2
=
-2^26*u^14*(1+u^2)^6*(9+25*u^2).


For every rational physical u!=0 this is nonzero. Therefore the current genus-2 twist family has no Q-rational reciprocal commuting involution of this form and no second elliptic quotient from the M3-T11-044 reciprocal mechanism.


This does not prove that Jac(H_{d,u}) is absolutely simple, and it does not exclude a genuinely non-reciprocal elliptic factor or other correspondence.


### 116.5 Route consequence and firewall


M3-T11-103 identifies the new arithmetic part of the audited M3-T11-102 square-coordinate cover exactly:
- old factor: the already-consumed fixed-u elliptic quotient E_u;
- new factor: the genus-2 quadratic-twist family H_{d,u};
- exact d-dependence: quadratic twist only on H_{d,u};
- available descent marker: one rational 2-torsion class on Jac(H_{d,u});
- closed cheap split: the reciprocal second-elliptic mechanism is uniformly absent.


The next legal interior attack is therefore an exact same-measure 2-descent/Selmer/support analysis of the physical image in Jac(H_{d,u}) as d=[2*Pi] and u move, with special attention to whether the audited interior-prime splitting condition for Q(sqrt(d)) constrains the genus-2 twist Selmer image. A genuinely non-reciprocal elliptic factor would also be admissible if proved with the required physical adapter. The independent theta moving-support route remains live.

## 118. M3-T11-105 — residual quartic étale component is generically S4; norm-only descent collapses


Status: PROVISIONAL GENERIC_S4_ETALE / NORM_ONLY_NO_GO / GENERIC_QUADRATIC_SPLIT_NO_GO / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / NO POWER SAVING.


Retain audited M3-T11-101/102 and provisional M3-T11-103/104. This card is conditional on promotion of the provisional dependency chain.


### 118.1 Exact normalization of the residual quartic


Put A=1+u^2 and use the M3-T11-103 quartic H_u(x). Define
z = A*x/(16*u^2).
Then exactly
H_u(x)=2^16*u^8*Q_u(z),
where
boxed:
Q_u(z)
=
A*z^4
-8*u*z^3
+(11*u^2-1)*z^2
+6*u*z
-u^2.


Its discriminant is
boxed:
Disc_z(Q_u)
=
-2^4*u^2*A^2*(25*u^2-2)^3.


For rational physical u!=0 this is nonzero, by the same rationality argument as M3-T11-103.


### 118.2 Generic irreducibility and S4 Galois group


The quartic Q_u(z) is primitive as a polynomial in z over Q[u]. At the specialization u=1,
Q_1(z)=2*z^4-8*z^3+10*z^2+6*z-1,
which is irreducible over Q (exact irreducibility check; equivalently one may certify it after reduction modulo 5).


A standard cubic resolvent of the monic normalization Q_u/A, after clearing the denominator A^3, is
R_u(y)
=
A^3*y^3
+(1-9*u^2-21*u^4-11*u^6)*y^2
+4*u^2*(u^4-10*u^2-11)*y
-4*u^2*(11*u^4+3*u^2+8).


At u=1, after removing an irrelevant nonzero scalar, this specializes to
y^3-5*y^2-10*y-11,
which is irreducible over Q; modulo 3 it has no root.


By Gauss specialization, both Q_u and its cubic resolvent are therefore irreducible over Q(u).


Moreover
Disc(Q_u)
=
(4*u*A*(25*u^2-2))^2 * (2-25*u^2),
so its discriminant squareclass over Q(u) is
[2-25*u^2],
which is nontrivial in Q(u)^*/Q(u)^{*2}.


Hence the standard quartic Galois criterion gives
boxed:
Gal(Q_u / Q(u)) = S4.


Consequences at the generic-function-field level:
- the residual quartic étale algebra is a genuine degree-4 field, not a product of quadratic algebras;
- the cubic resolvent does not split generically;
- there is no generic factorization of Q_u into two quadratic factors over Q(u);
- even adjoining the discriminant square root reduces S4 to A4, which is still transitive on the four roots, so the quartic remains generically irreducible over Q(u,sqrt(2-25*u^2)).


This is a generic statement only. Special rational u can have smaller Galois group or a reducible quartic and are not excluded.


### 118.3 The norm of the physical residual étale class is tautologically [-1]


Let theta be the class of z in the quartic algebra
K_u = Q(u)[theta]/(Q_u(theta)/A),
using the monic quartic Q_u/A.


For a physical point, the M3-T11-103 identities give
T^2=-A*H_u(x).
Since
H_u(x)=2^16*u^8*Q_u(z),
one gets
Q_u(z)/A
=
- T^2/(2^16*u^8*A^2)
=
- (T/(2^8*u^4*A))^2.


Therefore
boxed:
N_{K_u/Q(u)}(z-theta)
=
Q_u(z)/A
=
- (T/(2^8*u^4*A))^2,


and hence its norm squareclass is identically
boxed:
[N(z-theta)]=[-1].


Thus any attack that pushes the residual quartic 2-descent class only through its norm to Q^*/Q^{*2} loses d, q, and the moving support completely. Norm-only characters cannot supply an independent fixed-power saving.


This does NOT say that z-theta itself is a square in K_u, nor that the full genus-2 2-Selmer image collapses. The nontrivial S4 étale class in K_u^*/K_u^{*2} remains the live object.


### 118.4 Route consequence


The cheap residual genus-2 descent routes are now sharply separated:
- rational-Weierstrass component [x]: frozen by M3-T11-104 as [d];
- norm of the quartic étale component: frozen here as [-1];
- generic quadratic factor / two-quadratic norm split: absent because the residual quartic is generically S4.


The surviving interior route must therefore use genuinely non-norm information in the S4 quartic étale class z-theta, a specialization theorem controlling exceptional u, a non-reciprocal correspondence with an exact physical adapter, or a global cross-u support theorem. The independent theta moving-support route remains live.


No thin-set count, fixed-power saving, fixed-squareclass B^o(1) theorem, denominator-extreme support deficit, primary-gate closure, endpoint theorem, P(B)/M3(B) limit, or Perfect Cuboid nonexistence credit is obtained.

## 120. M3-T11-106 — physical z=S/2, interior 1+3 local factorization, odd-cubic squareclass collapse, and cubic-resonance router
Status: PROVISIONAL EXACT_PHYSICAL_NORMALIZATION / INTERIOR_LOCAL_1_PLUS_3_FACTORIZATION / ODD_CUBIC_SQUARECLASS_COLLAPSE / CUBIC_RESONANCE_ROUTER / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / NO POWER SAVING.


Retain hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-099/100/102/105 and the audited Section-48 interior fresh-prime allocation. Work on the exact same fixed-content/coefficient nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoint population with R<=B.


### 120.1 The M3-T11-105 physical coordinate is exactly z=S/2
M3-T11-102 uses x=d*q^2=2*Pi. Section 35 gives
Pi=4*u^2*S/(1+u^2).
M3-T11-105 defines
z=(1+u^2)*x/(16*u^2).
Therefore on every physical point,
boxed:
z=S/2.
This is an exact normalization identity on the existing physical measure; it is not a new density event.


### 120.2 Interior fresh primes force a canonical 1+3 local factorization
Fix an interior fresh p^lambda||m_i with 0<c_p<2*lambda. Put
k=2*lambda-c_p,
A=1+u^2,
n=v_p(A)=v_p(N_u)=2*lambda+c_p.
Here u=a/b with p not dividing a*b, so A=N_u/b^2. Every fresh p is odd and p==1 mod 4. Audited M3-T11-099/100 gives v_p(t)=k for S=s/t with p not dividing s. Hence, using z=S/2,
v_p(z)=-k.


For the audited M3-T11-105 quartic
Q_u(z)=A*z^4-8*u*z^3+(11*u^2-1)*z^2+6*u*z-u^2,
put w=z-u/2. Exact expansion gives
16*Q_u(u/2+w)
=
A*(A-1)*(A+27)
+8*A*(A+9)*u*w
+8*A*(3*A-5)*w^2
+32*(A-4)*u*w^3
+16*A*w^4.
In particular, modulo p,
boxed:
Q_u(z) == -8*u*(z-u/2)^3 (mod p).


The w-adic Newton polygon has lower vertices
(0,n), (3,0), (4,n).
Therefore Q_u over Q_p has one canonical linear factor and one total degree-3 factor. The unique linear root theta_inf lies in Q_p and satisfies
v_p(theta_inf)=-n.
The other three roots satisfy
v_p(theta-u/2)=n/3
in the algebraic closure.


Using the reciprocal polynomial y^4*Q_u(1/y), the small reciprocal root has
y_inf=A/(8*u)*(1+O(p^n)).
Since p is odd, 1+O(p) is a square. Hence
boxed:
[theta_inf]=[8*u/A]
in Q_p^*/Q_p^{*2}.


For the physical etale element, define the linear component
beta_p=z-theta_inf.
Because
v_p(z/theta_inf)=n-k=2*c_p>0,
the factor 1-z/theta_inf is a p-adic square. Thus
boxed:
[beta_p]=[-8*u/A].


### 120.3 Nonresonant interior primes have no independent non-norm cubic squareclass
If 3 does not divide n=2*lambda+c_p, the degree-3 Newton segment has gcd(3,n)=1, so the degree-3 factor is irreducible over Q_p. Let L_p/Q_p be that cubic field and let gamma_p be the degree-3 component of z-theta.


For odd p, both Q_p^*/Q_p^{*2} and L_p^*/L_p^{*2} have four elements. Because [L_p:Q_p]=3 is odd, restriction
Q_p^*/Q_p^{*2} -> L_p^*/L_p^{*2}
is injective and hence an isomorphism; norm is its inverse on squareclasses.


Audited M3-T11-105 gives the total norm squareclass [-1]. Since the linear factor has class [-8*u/A],
boxed:
[N_{L_p/Q_p}(gamma_p)]=[A/(8*u)],
and therefore
boxed:
[gamma_p]=res([A/(8*u)]).


Thus at every interior prime with 3 not dividing 2*lambda+c_p, the full local quartic-etale squareclass of the physical element is already determined by u/A:
([-8*u/A], res([A/(8*u)])).
There is no additional independent non-norm local squareclass on this branch. This is a local anti-loop theorem only; it is not a global Selmer collapse or a counting saving.


### 120.4 Exact cubic-resonance criterion
Now suppose n=3*m. Write
A=p^n*a_0
with a_0 a p-adic unit and put w=p^m*xi. Divide the translated equation by p^n and reduce modulo p. Up to a nonzero scalar the degree-3 residual polynomial is
boxed:
xi^3-kappa_p,
where
boxed:
kappa_p = 27*a_0*u/128 (mod p).


Hence the valuation-resonant branch splits exactly as follows.


- If p==5 mod 12, the cube map on F_p^* is bijective. The residual cubic has one linear and one irreducible quadratic factor, so the degree-3 local algebra splits 1+2.
- If p==1 mod 12 and kappa_p is a cube in F_p^*, the residual cubic splits into three linear factors.
- If p==1 mod 12 and kappa_p is not a cube, the residual cubic is irreducible; the odd-cubic squareclass collapse of §120.3 still applies.


Define a surviving cubic-resonant interior prime to mean:
3 | (2*lambda+c_p)
and
xi^3-kappa_p is reducible over F_p.
Equivalently:
- p==5 mod 12 and 3 | (2*lambda+c_p); or
- p==1 mod 12, 3 | (2*lambda+c_p), and kappa_p is a cube mod p.


Therefore any genuinely new primewise local non-norm information in the M3-T11-105 S4 etale class is confined to these cubic-resonant interior primes. Nonresonant interior primes are frozen.


### 120.5 Route consequence and firewall

to
InteriorS4EtaleCubicResonanceSupport.

The independent theta route remains live.

## 121. M3-T11-107 — all interior finite-cluster étale squareclasses collapse to the old selector; cubic resonance gives no new local 2-descent class
Status: PROVISIONAL EXACT_LOCAL_ETALE_COLLAPSE / CUBIC_RESONANCE_SQUARECLASS_NO_GO / NO_DOUBLE_CHARGE / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / NO POWER SAVING.


Retain hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-099/100/102/105 and provisional M3-T11-106. Work on the exact same fixed-content/coefficient nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoint population with R<=B.


### 121.1 The complementary degree-3 component is always the base class [z]
Fix an interior fresh prime p^lambda||m_i with 0<c_p<2*lambda. Put
k=2*lambda-c_p>0,
A=1+u^2,
n=2*lambda+c_p.
Provisional M3-T11-106 gives z=S/2 with
v_p(z)=-k,
and factors the local quartic étale algebra as one canonical Q_p-linear factor together with a complementary total degree-3 étale algebra E_p. Every root theta in the degree-3 part satisfies
v(theta-u/2)=n/3>0
in the algebraic closure. Since u is a p-adic unit, every such theta is a unit.


Let gamma_p=z-theta denote the complementary degree-3 component in E_p. In every field factor of E_p,
gamma_p
=
z*(1-theta/z).
Because v(theta/z)>0, the factor 1-theta/z is a 1-unit. The residue characteristic is odd, so every 1-unit is a square by Hensel. Therefore, componentwise and hence in the étale squareclass group,
boxed:
[gamma_p]=res_{E_p/Q_p}([z]).


This uses only k>0 and the finite-cluster valuation. It is independent of whether E_p is a cubic field, splits 1+2, or splits 1+1+1. In particular the M3-T11-106 cubic-resonance decomposition does not create a new squareclass degree of freedom.


### 121.2 The base class [z] is exactly the already-consumed interior selector
The exact physical identities are
z=S/2,
P=4*u^2*S/A.
Hence
boxed:
z/(A/(8*u))=P/u.


At the interior prime, audited M3-T11-099 gives
Pi_p=p^(4*lambda)*P
a p-adic unit and the exact local selector
chi_p(-rho*Pi_p)=+1,
where u==rho mod p and rho^2==-1 mod p.
Every fresh Gaussian prime satisfies p==1 mod 4, so chi_p(-1)=+1. Also chi_p(rho^(-1))=chi_p(rho). Therefore
chi_p(Pi_p/u)
=
chi_p(Pi_p/rho)
=
chi_p(rho*Pi_p)
=
+1.
Moreover
v_p(P/u)=-4*lambda
is even. Hence
boxed:
P/u is a square in Q_p,
and therefore
boxed:
[z]=[A/(8*u)]
in Q_p^*/Q_p^{*2}.


Thus the finite degree-3 component is not merely constrained by its norm:
boxed:
[gamma_p]=res([A/(8*u)])
for every interior prime, including every cubic-resonant prime.


### 121.3 Full local quartic étale class is predetermined
Provisional M3-T11-106 gives for the canonical linear component
boxed:
[beta_p]=[-8*u/A].
Combining with §121.2 gives the full physical local quartic étale squareclass
boxed:
([beta_p],[gamma_p])
=
([-8*u/A], res([A/(8*u)]))
for every interior fresh prime.


When E_p splits, the second entry is interpreted diagonally in each factor. Thus:
- irreducible cubic: the class is the base restriction;
- 1+2 resonance: both the rational and quadratic components receive the restriction of [A/(8*u)];
- 1+1+1 resonance: all three finite linear components receive [A/(8*u)].


As an exact consistency check,
[N_{E_p/Q_p}(gamma_p)]=[z]^3=[z],
so
[beta_p]*[N(gamma_p)]
=
[-8*u/A]*[A/(8*u)]
=
[-1],
exactly matching audited M3-T11-105.

## 122. M3-T11-108 — the standard cubic resolvent is irreducible for every nonzero rational u; the rational 2+2 specialization branch is empty
Status: PROVISIONAL UNIFORM_RATIONAL_RESOLVENT_IRREDUCIBILITY / EXCEPTIONAL_SPECIALIZATION_CUT / TWO_QUADRATIC_SPECIALIZATION_NO_GO / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / NO POWER SAVING.


Retain audited M3-T11-105/106/107. Work with the exact residual quartic
Q_u(z)=(1+u^2)z^4-8uz^3+(11u^2-1)z^2+6uz-u^2
and its M3-T11-105 standard cubic resolvent. This card addresses only the rational-specialization locus where that cubic resolvent becomes reducible. It does not assume or prove that every specialized quartic Q_u is irreducible.


### 122.1 Exact resolvent-root curve


Put v=u^2. After clearing the denominator in the monic resolvent, a rational resolvent root y is exactly a rational point on
F(v,y)=
(v+1)^3*y^3
+(-11*v^3-21*v^2-9*v+1)*y^2
+4*v*(v-11)*(v+1)*y
-4*v*(11*v^2+3*v+8)
=0.


Exact symbolic checks give
Disc_y(F)=-16*v*(v+1)^8*(25*v-2)^3,
Disc_v(F)=-256*(y+1)*(27*y+28)^3.


The normalization is rational. A birational parameter t is
v=-(t-2)*(t+1)^2/((t+4)*(t^2-4*t+13)),
y=-(t+1)*(2*t^2-11*t+23)/27.


Away from the finite inverse-exception locus, an exact inverse is
t=-2*(3*v*y+17*v+3*y+2)/(3*v*y-8*v+3*y+4).
The inverse denominator can vanish on F only at v=-1 or v=2/25. Neither value is a nonzero square in Q, so neither occurs on the physical specialization v=u^2 with u in Q^*.


### 122.2 Imposing v=u^2 produces a rank-zero elliptic curve


For u!=0 one has t!=-1. Write r=u/(t+1). The square condition v=u^2 is equivalent to
r^2=-(t-2)/((t+4)*(t^2-4*t+13)),
or, after clearing a square denominator,
W^2=-(t-2)*(t+4)*(t^2-4*t+13).


Put
X=-6/(t-2),
Y=2*W/(t-2)^2,
x=X-1.
Then this genus-one curve is birational to
E: Y^2=x*(x^2+2*x+5).


The Mordell-Weil group is exact and elementary here. For the standard 2-isogeny descent on
E: Y^2=x^3+2*x^2+5*x,
the alpha image is exactly {1,5}: x^2+2*x+5=(x+1)^2+4 is positive, so a rational point has x>=0, while O and (0,0) realize 1 and 5.


The 2-isogenous curve is
Ebar: Y^2=x^3-4*x^2-16*x.
Its possible alpha squareclasses are {1,-1,2,-2}. Classes +/-2 would require primitive integer solutions of
N^2=2*m^4-4*m^2*e^2-8*e^4
or
N^2=-2*m^4-4*m^2*e^2+8*e^4.
If m,e have opposite parity or are both odd, these right sides are respectively 2 or 8 or 6 mod 16 for d=2, and 14 or 8 or 2 mod 16 for d=-2. None is a square mod 16. Thus the Ebar alpha image is exactly {1,-1}.


The 2-isogeny rank formula therefore gives rank E(Q)=0.


For torsion, E has good reduction at 3 and #E(F_3)=2. The 3-division polynomial is
(x+1)*(3*x^3+5*x^2+25*x-25);
the cubic factor is irreducible over Q and x=-1 would require Y^2=-4, so E(Q) has no rational 3-torsion. Hence
E(Q)={O,(0,0)}.


### 122.3 Back-substitution closes the nonzero rational resolvent-reducible locus


The point O corresponds to t=2, which gives v=0 and u=0. The point (0,0) corresponds to X=1 and t=-4, where the rational parametrization has a pole and no finite u. The canceled value t=-1 also gives only v=0.


Therefore:
boxed:
for every u in Q^*, the standard cubic resolvent R_u(y) is irreducible over Q.


Since a cubic over Q is reducible exactly when it has a rational root, there are no further rational exceptions.


### 122.4 Exact consequence and firewall


For every nonzero rational u, Q_u cannot factor over Q as a product of two quadratic polynomials: such a 2+2 factorization would make one resolvent pairing rational and hence make the standard cubic resolvent reducible.


This upgrades the M3-T11-105 generic two-quadratic no-go to a uniform rational-specialization theorem.


It does NOT prove uniform Gal(Q_u/Q)=S4. Two genuinely different specialization issues remain:
- Q_u may in principle have a rational linear factor and a cubic factor; resolvent irreducibility does not exclude a 1+3 quartic factorization.
- on quartic-irreducible specializations, the discriminant squareclass [2-25*u^2] can specialize to a square, giving the A4 rather than S4 branch.


Thus the legal exceptional-specialization continuation is narrowed to exact control of the 1+3 locus and/or the A4 discriminant-square locus, or to genuinely global/nonlocal S4 etale-Selmer information. The independent theta moving-support route remains live.


POPULATION:
Exact fixed-content/coefficient nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoint population with R<=B. The theorem is actually uniform for all u in Q^*. Same measure; no density, height, denominator, multiplicity, primary-gate, endpoint, or P-over-M3 credit.

## 123. M3-T11-109 — complete rational specialization trichotomy: explicit 1+3 and A4 thin images, disjointness, generic S4 remainder


Status: PROVISIONAL EXACT_SPECIALIZATION_CLASSIFICATION / ONE_PLUS_THREE_PARAMETRIZATION / A4_PARAMETRIZATION / DISJOINT_THIN_IMAGES / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / NO POWER SAVING.


Retain hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-105/106/107/108. Work with
Q_u(z)=(1+u^2)z^4-8u z^3+(11u^2-1)z^2+6u z-u^2,
for u in Q^*. M3-T11-108 already proves that the standard cubic resolvent is irreducible for every such u, hence no rational 2+2 factorization exists.


### 123.1 Exact rational 1+3 locus


Regard Q_u(z) as a quadratic in u:
Q_u(z)
=(z^4+11z^2-1)u^2+(-8z^3+6z)u+(z^4-z^2).


Its u-discriminant is exactly
Disc_u(Q_u(z))=-4z^2(z^2-2)^3=4z^2(2-z^2)^3.


For u!=0, a rational root z cannot have z=0. Also z^4+11z^2-1 cannot vanish for rational z, because its equation in z^2 has discriminant 125. Therefore a rational root exists exactly when
2-z^2=w^2
for some w in Q, equivalently
z^2+w^2=2.


Solving the quadratic gives
u=z(4z^2-3+w^3)/(z^4+11z^2-1),
with w->-w exchanging the two quadratic roots.


Parametrize z^2+w^2=2 by t in P^1(Q):
z=(t^2-2t-1)/(t^2+1),
w=-(t^2+2t-1)/(t^2+1).


Then the complete rational-root specialization locus is the image of
phi(t)
=-2(t-1)(t^2-2t-1)/(t^4-6t^3+12t^2-14t+11).


Thus, for u in Q^*,
Q_u has a rational linear factor
iff
u in phi(P^1(Q)) minus {0}.


In homogeneous coordinates t=r/s,
U_13=-2s(r-s)(r^2-2rs-s^2),
V_13=r^4-6r^3s+12r^2s^2-14rs^3+11s^4.
Both have degree 4 and
Res_r(U_13,V_13)=-4096 s^16.
For primitive (r,s), any reduction gcd is therefore uniformly bounded and supported at 2. Hence phi is a degree-4 morphism and
h(phi(t))=4h(t)+O(1).


Consequently, in ordinary multiplicative projective u-height H,
#{u in phi(P^1(Q)): H(u)<=H}=O(H^(1/2)).
This is ambient u-height sparsity only. It is not yet a same-physical-measure R<=B saving.


### 123.2 Exact A4 discriminant-square locus


M3-T11-105 gives
Disc_z(Q_u)=-16u^2(1+u^2)^2(25u^2-2)^3,
so its squareclass is [2-25u^2].


Thus the discriminant is a rational square exactly when
y^2=2-25u^2.
Writing X=5u gives the same conic X^2+y^2=2, hence the complete locus is
u=psi(t)
=(t^2-2t-1)/(5(t^2+1)),
t in P^1(Q).


In homogeneous coordinates,
U_A4=r^2-2rs-s^2,
V_A4=5(r^2+s^2),
and
Res_r(U_A4,V_A4)=200 s^4.
Thus psi is a degree-2 morphism with uniformly bounded reduction cancellation, so
h(psi(t))=2h(t)+O(1)
and
#{u in psi(P^1(Q)): H(u)<=H}=O(H).


Again this is ambient u-height sparsity only and carries no Stage37 fixed-power credit.


### 123.3 The 1+3 and A4 images are disjoint over Q


Substitution u=phi(t) gives exactly
2-25phi(t)^2
=
2(t^2+2t-1)^2
(t^4-16t^3+72t^2-124t+71)
/(t^4-6t^3+12t^2-14t+11)^2.


Hence an intersection point would give a rational point on
Y^2=2F(r,s),
where
F(r,s)=r^4-16r^3s+72r^2s^2-124rs^3+71s^4.


Modulo 5, for every [r:s] in P^1(F_5),
2F(r,s) is one of 2 or 3.
For finite t=0,1,2,3,4 the values are 2,3,3,2,3, and at infinity the value is 2.
These are nonzero nonsquares modulo 5.


Therefore
phi(P^1(Q)) intersect psi(P^1(Q)) is empty.


As a cross-check, after substituting u=phi(t) and dividing Q_u(x) by its rational linear factor, the cubic factor has discriminant
128(t-1)^2(1+t^2)^6(t^2-4t+5)^2
(t^4-16t^3+72t^2-124t+71)^3,
whose squareclass is exactly 2F(t).


### 123.4 Complete rational specialization trichotomy


Combine Sections 123.1-123.3 with hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-108.


For every u in Q^*, exactly one of the following occurs:


1. u in phi(P^1(Q)):
   Q_u factors as exactly 1+3 over Q. The cubic factor is irreducible, and because the discriminant is nonsquare its splitting-field Galois group is S3.


2. u in psi(P^1(Q)):
   Q_u is irreducible over Q and has square discriminant. Since the cubic resolvent is irreducible, Gal(Q_u/Q)=A4.


3. u outside both images:
   Q_u is irreducible, its cubic resolvent is irreducible, and its discriminant is nonsquare. Hence Gal(Q_u/Q)=S4.


No rational 2+2 branch remains, and the two surviving exceptional Galois loci are explicit, disjoint rational images of degrees 4 and 2.


### 123.5 Route consequence and firewall


This closes the purely algebraic rational-specialization classification left open after M3-T11-108. It does NOT by itself close the Stage37 counting receiver.


The ambient height estimates
O(H^(1/2)) for the 1+3 image and O(H) for the A4 image
cannot be converted into a fixed power of B merely from the existing statement that physical u has height B^O(1). An exact same-measure R<=B adapter is still required before any counting credit can be charged.


On the complement of these two explicit images, the residual quartic is uniformly S4. Therefore the generic interior route can now assume S4 after separating two explicit thin specialization images, but genuinely global/nonlocal S4 etale-Selmer information is still required for a new saving.

Let p be any relative-fresh prime with
n=v_p(a^2+b^2)>0.
The existing fresh support is odd and split in Q(i), and the previous paragraph excludes p=5.


Because p does not divide b, define the exact common-u square root
rho == a*b^(-1) (mod p^n).
Then
rho^2 == -1 (mod p^n),
and the rational identity a/b=N/(5Q0) gives
N-5rho Q0 == 0 (mod p^n).


Equivalently the primitive projective parameter [r:s] is a zero modulo p^n of
F_rho(r,s)
=(1-5rho)r^2-2rs+(-1-5rho)s^2.


Using rho^2=-1, the binary discriminant is exactly
Delta_rho
=(-2)^2-4(1-5rho)(-1-5rho)
==108 (mod p^n).


Modulo p the physical projective zero is nontrivial. Since p is odd and p!=3, isotropy of this nondegenerate binary quadratic forces 108, hence 3, to be a square mod p. Together with rho^2=-1, so p==1 mod4, quadratic reciprocity gives
p==1 mod12.


Therefore every relative-fresh prime supporting M_rel on the psi/A4 image satisfies
p==1 mod12.


### 127.3 Exact depth-n projective lift


For p==1 mod12, 108 is a p-adic unit square. Hence F_rho factors into two distinct p-adic linear factors and the primitive t=[r:s] lies on exactly two simple projective root lines modulo p^n.


Using the audited fresh saturation
n=v_p(a^2+b^2)=2lambda+c_p
for p^lambda||M_rel, the psi adapter therefore retains the full exact depth
p^(2lambda+c_p),
not merely the first residue class.


This is not an independent modulus charge: rho is the already-existing common-u Gaussian root. M3-T11-111 only identifies its exact degree-two pullback to the psi parameter line.


### 127.4 A4 local splitting router


The global residual quartic on the psi image has Galois group A4. At an interior fresh prime, audited M3-T11-106 gives one canonical Q_p-rational root plus a degree-3 finite cluster. The stabilizer of one point in A4 is C3. Therefore the finite cubic local factor is either
- irreducible cyclic cubic, or
- fully split 1+1+1.


A 1+2 finite-cluster factorization is impossible on the psi/A4 image.


This refines the cubic-resonance router but does not create a new primewise squareclass event; M3-T11-107 remains in force.


### 127.5 Counting firewall


The restriction p==1 mod12 is a split-prime support restriction and by itself has only logarithmic-scale sieve strength. The two t-root lines are a pullback of the already-consumed common-u root line. Neither may be multiplied as an independent density gain.


No fixed-power, multiplicity, primary-gate, endpoint, P(B)/M3(B), or Perfect Cuboid nonexistence credit is claimed.

M3-T11-112 — Psi fixed-conductor primitive lattice counting adapter
STATUS=PROVISIONAL / EXACT_SAME_MEASURE_UPPER_BOUND / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / NO_FIXED_POWER_SAVING
TYPE=QUANTITATIVE_ADAPTER / PRIMITIVE_PARAMETER_COUNT / MOVING_MODULUS_FIREWALL
POPULATION=Exact nondegenerate physical Stage37 endpoints with R<=B in one fixed content/coefficient packet, restricted to psi/A4. One physical endpoint is one count.
DEPENDENCIES=111 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS; 109 exact degree-two psi parametrization; 040/041/043 capped common-u conductor; 036 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS uniform fixed-u physical multiplicity.
DUPLICATE_SEARCH=Compared RESULT-LEDGER, NEGATIVE-REGISTER, ROUTE and CARD-INDEX. Existing 029/030 fixed root-line occupancy and 046 primitive lattices are related engines; they do not give this psi depth pullback plus uniform primitive fixed-conductor bound. No prior saving or retired density route is reopened.
ALIASES=PsiA4PrimitiveFixedConductorCount; PsiDepthRootLineLatticeUpperBound.


STATEMENT.
Let M=M_rel, C=C_u with 0<=v_p(C)<=2v_p(M), and L=M^2 C. Fix M,C (hence L), and restrict physical points to those having at least one primitive psi parameter [r:s] with max(|r|,|s|)<=H, H>=1. Denote their number E_psi(B;M,C,H). Then
E_psi(B;M,C,H) << B^o(1) 4^omega(M) (H^2/L+1).
On the polynomial physical range, equivalently
E_psi(B;M,C,H) << B^o(1) (H^2/(M^2 C)+1).
The B^o(1) factor is the previously audited fixed-u physical multiplicity, not new multiplicity credit.
For a fixed oriented rho modulo L and one choice of the two psi root lines at every p, the primitive parameter count is O(H^2/L+1), with an absolute constant independent of lattice shape.


PROOF.
(i) Audited 111 gives p=1 mod12 at every p|M. Choose the existing common-u Gaussian root rho modulo L. At extreme c_p=2lambda, L uses only the capped depth 4lambda, which is valid even if the actual norm valuation is larger. No unjustified exact saturation is needed.
(ii) At each p^n||L the binary quadratic N-5rho Q0 has exactly two simple projective root lines. A line is the kernel of a primitive covector modulo p^n, including the infinity chart. Selecting one at every p and using CRT gives a primitive covector modulo L. Its kernel in Z^2 is a rank-two lattice Lambda of determinant exactly L: the covector map Z^2 -> Z/L is surjective.
(iii) Primitive lattice lemma. Choose a Gauss-reduced integral basis b1,b2 of Lambda, with |b1|<=|b2| and angle between 60 and 120 degrees. Then |b1||b2| is comparable to det(Lambda)=L. If v=m b1+n b2 has sup norm <=H, elementary inversion gives |m|<=K H/|b1| and |n|<=K H/|b2| for an absolute K. A Z^2-primitive v must have gcd(m,n)=1, since a common divisor divides both integer coordinates of v. For n=0 only m=+/-1 can survive. For n!=0, if such a vector occurs then both H/|b1| and H/|b2| are bounded below by an absolute positive constant. Thus the number is O((H/|b1|)(H/|b2|))=O(H^2/L). Adding the n=0 contribution proves O(H^2/L+1). This is a deterministic upper bound, including highly anisotropic lattices; there is no H/lambda1 error term.
(iv) There are at most 2^omega(M) Gaussian orientations and 2^omega(M) pullback line choices, hence at most 4^omega(M) lattices. Sum their upper bounds. Counting signed primitive pairs overcounts projective parameters by only a bounded factor.
(v) Every counted physical endpoint has a parameter in this set. Each parameter determines exactly one u=psi(r/s); apply audited 036 to bound physical multiplicity for each realized u by B^o(1). Extra endpoint equations and exact R<=B restrictions are monotone post-filters. No ambient density is substituted for the physical population.


HEIGHT AND MOVING-CONDUCTOR CONSEQUENCE.
H is a stated parameter-height cutoff, not an asserted power of B. The exact psi height relation is h(u)=2h(t)+O(1) for logarithmic heights, but no new sharp physical B-exponent is proved here.
For finitely many fixed conductor pairs (M,C) in a shell, with a common valid cutoff H, the rigorous union upper bound is
B^o(1) sum_(M,C) (H^2/(M^2 C)+1).
Duplicates only enlarge this upper bound.
To bound active realized u-values below B^(1/12-delta), it is sufficient to establish that this actual physical-shell sum is O(B^(1/12-delta)), or to replace the separate-modulus sum by a sharper joint incidence bound. Such an estimate is NOT proved.
The +1 term records the thin-lattice / large-modulus occupancy obstruction: when L>H^2, this method gives O(B^o(1)) per conductor pair rather than a reciprocal-L gain that can be summed freely. No physical lower-bound or actual endpoint existence is asserted by this observation.


IMPLIES=The psi fixed-conductor counting adapter is quantitative, but moving-conductor occupancy and a sharp physical height relation remain the blockers.

M3-T11-113 — Psi norm-squareclass twist compression and joint large-conductor tail
STATUS=PROVISIONAL / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / EXACT_SAME_MEASURE_THEOREM_ADAPTER
TYPE=FIXED_SQUARECLASS_UNIFORM_FIBER / MOVING_CONDUCTOR_JOINT_TAIL / HEIGHT_WINDOW_POWER_BOUND
POPULATION=Exact nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoints with R<=B in one fixed content/coefficient packet, restricted to the audited psi/A4 image. One endpoint is one count.
DEPENDENCIES=109 psi parametrization; corrected 111; audited 112; 035/040/041 exact common-u conductor; 036 audited fixed-u physical multiplicity and polynomial physical coordinate-height machinery; Dujella Theorem 1.1.
DUPLICATE_SEARCH=RESULT-LEDGER, NEGATIVE-REGISTER, active ROUTE and CARD-INDEX were compared. The earlier genus-2 fixed-squareclass variable d in 101..107 is sf(2Pi), not the variable below. This card fixes sf(a^2+b^2) only on psi, using a new fixed norm quartic. It does not reopen local S4 squareclass work or ordinary fixed-theta Kummer.
ALIASES=PsiCommonUNormSquareclassTwistCompression; PsiJointLargeMConductorTail; PsiLowParameterHeightOneTwelfthWindow.
DUPLICATE_OF=NONE.


1. Exact norm and reduction.
Write primitive psi parameter t=r/s and
N=r^2-2rs-s^2, Q0=r^2+s^2, u=N/(5Q0).
Define
F(r,s)=N^2+25Q0^2
=26r^4-4r^3s+52r^2s^2+4rs^3+26s^4.
IMPORTANT_COEFFICIENT=52, not 48.
For primitive (r,s), g=gcd(N,5Q0) is exactly 1 or 2. Odd common divisors of N,Q0 are excluded by the resultant 8s^4; N has no primitive zero mod5. For mixed parity g=1; for both odd N,Q0 each have valuation exactly 1 at 2, so g=2.
Thus reduced u=a/b has
a^2+b^2=F(r,s)/g^2.
The canonical positive squarefree kernel
d=sf(a^2+b^2)=sf(F(r,s))
is independent of the parameter preimage: g^2 and projective scaling are squares.
For H=max(|r|,|s|), |N|<=4H^2 and Q0<=2H^2, hence
0<F(r,s)<=116H^4.
This is a direct height inequality; no physical B-exponent for H is imported.


2. New fixed-d genus-one fiber.
For a positive squarefree d, write F(r,s)=d q^2. Then the parameter point lies on the smooth genus-one double cover
C_d: Y^2=d F(t,1),
with Y=d q/s^2 on the finite chart, and the projective infinity chart retained.
For the binary quartic F, using the same scaled-Jacobian convention as 036:
I=10864,
J=2219776,
4I^3-J^2=201553920000 !=0.
For dF the invariants are I_d=d^2 I, J_d=d^3 J. Therefore
E_d: y^2=x^3-293328d^2 x-59933952d^3
=(x-624d)(x+276d)(x+348d).
For every d>0 the three roots are distinct. Consequently E_d has full rational 2-torsion over Q; in particular (624d,0) has exact order 2.
This family is a rational quadratic-twist family of one fixed elliptic curve, not the old fixed-u or fixed-theta family.


3. Uniform fixed-d parameter and physical count.
Assume H<=B^A for one fixed A, as allowed by the audited polynomial physical range. For realized d, d<=116H^4<=B^O_A(1).
The standard degree-four binary-quartic 2-cover C_d -> Jac(C_d)=E_d, used as a counting interface in 036, has fixed-degree algebraic formulas whose coefficient heights grow polynomially in d. Thus a parameter point of height <=H and Y=d q/s^2 maps to an E_d(Q) point of naive x-height B^O_A(1). Branch/pole/infinity charts contribute only bounded exceptional points.
The model height h(E_d)=O(log d)=O_A(log B).
The canonical-height comparison quoted in Dujella's paper gives canonical height O_A(log B). Choose a single enlarged height parameter T=B^K_A, with K_A fixed and large enough both for the induced point bound and T>=exp(max(h(E_d),e)).
Dujella Theorem 1.1 applies over the fixed field Q with prime order 2:
# such E_d(Q) points <=exp(O_A(log B/log log B))=B^o(1),
uniformly for every realized d.
The covering degree is four, so fixed d gives B^o(1) primitive projective psi parameters in the physical polynomial-height range. Composing each parameter t -> u with audited 036 gives B^o(1) physical endpoints for fixed d and fixed packet. Two subpolynomial bounds multiply to a subpolynomial bound; they are not charged as separate density savings.


4. Joint large-conductor tail — no per-modulus +1 sum.
Let E_psi(B;H,M0) count those exact physical endpoints admitting a primitive psi parameter of height <=H and with their actual M_rel>=M0>=1.
The audited common-u conductor gives M_rel^2 | a^2+b^2, hence M_rel^2 | F(r,s).
Removing the square factor M_rel^2 preserves d and leaves a positive integer, so
d=sf(F/M_rel^2)<=F/M_rel^2<=116H^4/M0^2.
Therefore every endpoint is routed once by its canonical d to one of at most
D=floor(116H^4/M0^2)
positive squarefree integer values.
Applying (3) to each d gives the provisional same-measure upper bound
E_psi(B;H,M0) <<_A B^o(1) H^4/M0^2.
If D=0 the subset is empty. The elementary ambient parameter upper bound plus 036 also gives B^o(1)H^2; hence
E_psi(B;H,M0) <<_A B^o(1) min(H^2,H^4/M0^2).
This sums over all moving actual M_rel and C_u simultaneously. It does not sum 112's +1 over conductor pairs, and it does not assume any distribution or independence of d.
The incremental C_u is not charged; only the already-existing square M_rel^2 is used as a deterministic divisor in a replacement count.


5. Precisely scoped exponent consequence.
On a height/conductor window H<=B^h and M_rel>=B^m, the new bound is
E_psi << B^(4h-2m+o(1)).
Thus a one-twelfth support deficit is obtained for this psi subpopulation if
4h-2m<1/12.
For the hard conductor threshold m=1/12-eta, it is sufficient to have
h<1/16-eta/2.
For example H<=B^(1/16-epsilon), M_rel>=B^(1/12-eta), with 4epsilon>2eta, gives
E_psi << B^(1/12-4epsilon+2eta+o(1)).
This is a bounded-height-window result only. No claim is made that all physical psi endpoints satisfy this small parameter-height bound. The remaining high-height psi region is uncontrolled by this one-twelfth argument.
No primary-gate closure, total numerator improvement or P/M3 limit is claimed.

## 130. Incremental-conductor squarepart adapter


M3-T11-114 — Psi incremental-conductor squarepart tail and parity-sensitive height window
STATUS=PROVISIONAL / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / EXACT_SAME_MEASURE_UPPER_BOUND
TYPE=INCREMENTAL_CONDUCTOR_ADAPTER / JOINT_SQUARECLASS_TAIL / PARITY_SENSITIVE_HEIGHT_WINDOW
POPULATION=Exact nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoints with R<=B in one fixed content/coefficient packet, restricted to psi/A4; one endpoint is one count.
DEPENDENCIES=113 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS; 040/041/043 capped conductor; corrected 111; 036 uniform fixed-u multiplicity.
ALIASES=PsiIncrementalConductorSquarepartTail; PsiConductorParityHeightWindow.
DUPLICATE_SEARCH=RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE, NEGATIVE-REGISTER and CARD-INDEX checked for squarepart/parity/conductor variants. 112 is a fixed-modulus lattice count; 113 used M_rel^2 only and explicitly left C_u uncharged. Older squarefree kernels belong to different populations or equations. This result newly routes the incremental C_u squarepart into the joint norm-squareclass count.
DUPLICATE_OF=NONE.


1. Exact parity-safe square divisor.
Let M=M_rel and C=C_u. The accepted divisibility is
M^2*C | N_u=a^2+b^2,
with 0<=c_p=v_p(C)<=2lambda_p for every p^lambda_p||M.
Write uniquely C=kappa*T^2, where kappa=sf(C) is squarefree and
T=product_(p|M) p^floor(c_p/2).
Define S_sq=M*T. This symbol is NOT the existing symmetric coordinate S.
Then exactly
S_sq^2=M^2*C/kappa | N_u,
M<=S_sq<=M^2.
Only divisibility is used. The formula remains valid at capped extreme depth even if actual norm valuations exceed the cap. No old exact-saturation assertion is imported.
For psi, N_u=F(r,s)/g^2, g in {1,2}, so S_sq^2|F as well.


2. Joint actual-conductor upper bound.
Let E_psi(B;H,S0) count the physical subset admitting a primitive psi parameter of height<=H and whose actual S_sq>=S0>=1.
The canonical d=sf(N_u)=sf(F) satisfies
d=sf(N_u/S_sq^2)<=N_u/S_sq^2<=116H^4/S0^2.
Audited 113 gives B^o(1) physical endpoints uniformly per d; sum over canonical d only, simultaneously over all M,C.
Thus for H<=B^A,
E_psi(B;H,S0)<<_A B^o(1)min(H^2,H^4/S0^2).
If floor(116H^4/S0^2)=0 the subset is empty.
In a shell M>=M0, C>=C0, kappa<=K0, every endpoint has S_sq^2>=M0^2*C0/K0, hence
E_psi<<_A B^o(1)min(H^2,H^4*K0/(M0^2*C0)).
K0>=1. No sum over conductor pairs or kappa values is needed. This is one replacement count, not 113 multiplied by a new independent probability.


3. Exponent window and gain over 113.
If H<=B^h, M>=B^m, C>=B^c, kappa<=B^k, then
E_psi<<B^(4h-2m-c+k+o(1)).
It beats one-twelfth on this subset if
4h-2m-c+k<1/12.
On the extreme amplified allocation C=M^2, kappa=1 and S_sq=M^2. Therefore the joint upper bound over all M>=B^m is
E_psi<<B^(4h-4m+o(1)),
and suffices when h<m+1/48.
For m=1/12-eta this allows h<5/48-eta, compared with 113's h<1/16-eta/2.
Example: H<=B^(5/48-epsilon), M>=B^(1/12-eta), C=M^2, epsilon>eta implies
E_psi<<B^(1/12-4epsilon+4eta+o(1)).
This includes a wider height window on this allocation, but no assertion that all physical psi endpoints lie in it or in the extreme allocation.


4. Parity obstruction and precise remaining receiver.
One cannot replace S_sq^2 by M^2*C unless C is a square. Odd c_p leaves p in kappa. Example lambda=1,c_p=1 gives C=p, kappa=p and S_sq=M: no new square divisor is extracted.
A large C alone therefore supplies no polynomial improvement if kappa is comparably large.
For a dyadic parameter shell H~B^h, a sufficient low-occupancy condition is
S_sq>=B^(2h-1/24+epsilon),
giving E_psi<<B^(1/12-2epsilon+o(1)).
The still-uncontrolled physical subset is high parameter height with small S_sq relative to this threshold. Within the amplified-u branch C>=M, this includes high odd-valuation kernel kappa, not just large C.
The old complementary identity Q_S*C=M^2 remains available; no distribution/correlation theorem for kappa, Q_S, H or actual endpoints is proved here.


5. Supporting checks and firewall.
48 valuation profiles lambda=1..6, c=0..2lambda, with three actual norm depths at or above the guaranteed depth, verified S_sq^2=M^2*C/kappa, divisibility and sf(norm)<=norm/S_sq^2.
The exact proof is the displayed primewise floor formula and audited 113 routing; finite tests are supporting only.
IMPLIES=Incremental C_u can strengthen the joint psi bound only through its squarepart. A larger scoped height window exists on C=M^2; high-height/low-squarepart occupancy remains the blocker.

## 131. Psi core-supported norm-squareclass compression


M3-T11-115 — Psi core-supported norm squareclass compression without a small parameter-height cutoff
STATUS=PROVISIONAL / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / EXACT_SAME_MEASURE_SUPPORT_ADAPTER
TYPE=GLOBAL_CORE_SUPPORT_LOCALIZATION / FIXED_SUPPORT_UNIFORM_FIBER / HEIGHT_FREE_SUPPORT_WINDOW
POPULATION=Exact nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoints with R<=B in one fixed content/coefficient packet, restricted to psi/A4. One endpoint is one count.
DEPENDENCIES=113 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS; audited 114; corrected 111; 036 polynomial physical heights; corrected three-anti-root denominator carriers (ROUTE section 32); 033 fixed-content support; the integer-normal-form M3-T11-042 entry, explicitly identified by N_u/g_u|D (not the other historical 042 entry).
ALIASES=PsiCoreSupportedNormSquareclassCompression; PsiCommonCoreRadicalTimesActualRelativeOddKernel.
DUPLICATE_SEARCH=MAIN/INDEX/RESULT-LEDGER/ROUTE/NEGATIVE-REGISTER and CARD-INDEX checked for d_rel, core radical and norm-support variants. 084/085 localized the residual kernel on the retired x=-1/8 carrier, where relative norm valuations are even. This result instead treats the live psi/A4 population, retains its actual relative odd kernel, and uses 113's new fixed norm-quartic fibers. 113/114 only bounded d by parameter height divided by a square divisor. This result counts core-supported d without a small-H cutoff.
DUPLICATE_OF=NONE.


1. Retained support carrier and explicit packet primes.
Write the corrected anti-roots v_i=A_i/B_i reduced, D=B_1*B_2*B_3 and R_rel=tau_1*tau_2*tau_3.
The valid complementary carriers are
B_1 | L_1*(tau_0*tau_2*tau_3)^2,
B_2 | L_2*(tau_0*tau_1*tau_3)^2,
B_3 | L_3*(tau_0*tau_1*tau_2)^2,
where each L_i is a positive fixed-packet factor in the retained polynomial range.
Multiplying gives
D | L_1*L_2*L_3*tau_0^6*R_rel^4.
For the canonical reduced u=a/b, N_u=a^2+b^2 and g_u=gcd(4,N_u) in {1,2}, the integer-normal-form identity gives
N_u/g_u | D.
Consequently
N_u | 2*L_1*L_2*L_3*tau_0^6*R_rel^4.
Only support containment is needed. No false same-v CRT from old section 31 is used.


Let P_pkt=2*L_1*L_2*L_3*c_1*c_2*c_3 and Delta_pkt=rad(P_pkt).
Keep these packet primes explicitly: L_i may contain coefficient primes outside the content-prime set.
P_pkt is fixed within the packet and <=B^K for one fixed retained K, so
2^omega(P_pkt)=B^o(1).
This follows from the primorial/factorial lower bound, uniformly over the allowed polynomial packets.


2. Actual relative odd kernel, not a capped proxy.
Let d=sf(N_u) be 113's canonical positive norm squareclass.
Define
d_rel=gcd(d,rad(M_rel))
=product_(p|M_rel, v_p(N_u) odd) p.
Set R0=rad(tau_0^sharp), with tau_0^sharp the part of tau_0 outside the content-prime set, and
Xi=R0*d_rel.
Xi is a positive integer in the polynomial physical range; it is not an independent random coordinate.
All primes of R_rel/M_rel lie in the content-prime set. Thus if p|d but p does not divide Delta_pkt*M_rel, the support carrier in (1) forces p|tau_0^sharp. Since d is squarefree,
d | Delta_pkt*R0*d_rel = Delta_pkt*Xi.


3. Uniform fixed-Xi physical count; all physical parameter heights included.
For any fixed Xi, at most 2^omega(Delta_pkt*Xi)=B^o(1) squarefree values d divide Delta_pkt*Xi.
Audited 113 gives B^o(1) physical psi endpoints per d, uniformly on the retained polynomial physical-height range. Hence
# physical psi endpoints compatible with fixed Xi << B^o(1).
No count of M_rel,C_u, anti-root triples, parameter heights or Gaussian orientations is multiplied into this estimate. They are all absorbed within the canonical fixed-d physical fiber.
Every physical psi point has a polynomial parameter-height bound: reduced psi denominator is b=5(r^2+s^2)/g with g in {1,2}, so H(t)^2<=r^2+s^2=g*b/5<=2b/5. Polynomial physical height of u from 036 therefore places its primitive psi preimages in 113's allowed polynomial range. No H<=B^(1/16) or other small exponent is assumed.


Let E_psi(B;Xi<=Z) count physical endpoints admitting a retained core representation with Xi<=Z, Z>=1 polynomially bounded. Then
E_psi(B;Xi<=Z)<<B^o(1)*Z.
If a core representation is not unique, the union over integer Xi values is still an upper bound and endpoints remain counted once. No injectivity of Xi is needed.
In particular Xi<=B^(1/12-delta) gives
E_psi<<B^(1/12-delta+o(1))
with no small parameter-height cutoff.
More generally any allowed Xi support set of cardinality A(B) gives A(B)*B^o(1).


4. Connection to 114 and the extreme-depth guard.
At p^lambda||M_rel, corrected 111 gives min(v_p(N_u),4lambda)=2lambda+c_p.
For c_p<2lambda, actual parity equals c_p mod2.
For c_p=2lambda, actual valuation may exceed 4lambda; its excess parity must be retained.
Define
e_ext=product_(p|M_rel, c_p=2lambda_p, v_p(N_u) odd) p.
Then with kappa=sf(C_u),
d_rel=kappa*e_ext.
Their supports are disjoint, because extreme capped c_p is even.
Thus the new receiver is explicitly
Xi=rad(tau_0^sharp)*sf(C_u)*e_ext.
Do not silently set e_ext=1 from capped data. Even C_u=M_rel^2 only implies kappa=1; actual even norm valuation is an additional condition for d_rel=1.


For the actual-even relative stratum d_rel=1, the subset R0<=B^(1/12-delta) is small at the same physical one-twelfth scale for every physical parameter height.
For general d_rel, a sufficient window is R0<=B^a and d_rel<=B^b with a+b<1/12.
On an intersection also satisfying 114's H,S0 cutoffs one may take the minimum of valid upper bounds:
E_psi<<B^o(1)*min(Z,H^2,H^4/S0^2).
This is a minimum of replacement counts, not a product of savings.


5. What remains unresolved.
The result does not prove that every psi endpoint has small Xi, or that the occupied Xi support has cardinality below B^(1/12).
Large Xi can arise from a large all-same core radical, a large actual relative odd kernel, or both. Such large support is the new minimal global occurrence/correlation receiver.
Some high-H/low-S_sq points are now controlled if Xi is small; no claim is made that all such points are controlled.
The fixed Xi fiber bound does not itself constrain how many Xi values occur. Bounding occupied Xi cardinality is necessary before claiming total psi support saving.
The local S4 tuple remains frozen, x=-1/8 stays retired, and phi/nonlocal S4/theta!=0 remain live.

## 132. Complementary norm-cofactor and two-sided height-free support window


# M3-T11-116 — complementary norm-cofactor fibers and a height-free two-sided window


STATUS=PROVISIONAL / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / EXACT_SAME_MEASURE_UPPER_BOUND
TYPE=COMPLEMENTARY_NORM_COFACTOR / JOINT_MOVING_CORE_COUNT / TWO_SIDED_SUPPORT_WINDOW
POPULATION=Exact nondegenerate physical Stage37 psi/A4 endpoints with R<=B in one fixed content/coefficient packet; one endpoint is one count.
DEPENDENCIES=Audited 113, 114, 115; corrected denominator carriers; integer-normal-form N_u/g_u|D; polynomial physical range from 036.
ALIASES=PsiComplementaryNormCofactor; PsiTwoSidedNormSquarepartWindow.
DUPLICATE_SEARCH=Current MAIN/INDEX/RESULT-LEDGER/active ROUTE checked for norm quotient/cofactor and complementary squareclass variants. Older theta cofactors and elliptic/genus-2 quotients concern different equations/populations. 113/114 count small norm squareclasses; 115 counts small core support. None uses the integer quotient of the live psi norm into its even-power core carrier. DUPLICATE_OF=NONE.


## 1. Integral cofactor with fixed-packet squareclass


Let L=L1*L2*L3, Rrel=tau1*tau2*tau3, and define


W_car=2*L*tau0^6*Rrel^4,
J_car=W_car/N_u.


Audited 115 gives N_u | W_car, so J_car is a positive integer. This symbol J_car is unrelated to the binary-quartic invariant J=2219776. W_car is not the actual reduced denominator D: it is an upper divisibility carrier. No equality D=W_car is assumed.


The core contribution tau0^6*Rrel^4 is a square. From N_u*J_car=W_car it follows exactly that


d=sf(N_u)=sf(2*L*J_car).


Thus for fixed J_car and the fixed packet, d is uniquely determined. Audited 113 gives B^o(1) physical psi endpoints for that d. This absorbs all moving core choices, conductor allocations, orientations and parameter heights; none is charged again. If endpoints admit several retained core representations, union counting remains valid.


For Y>=1 in the polynomial physical range,


E_psi(B; J_car<=Y) << B^o(1)*Y.


More generally an allowed J_car support set of cardinality A gives A B^o(1). This receiver applies to large-Xi endpoints as well: no condition on rad(tau0^sharp)*d_rel is imposed. It does not prove J_car small globally.


## 2. A high-parameter-height window


Write the primitive psi parameter t=r/s and H=max(|r|,|s|). Audited reduction gives N_u=F(r,s)/g^2, g in {1,2}, where


F=(r^2-2rs-s^2)^2+25(r^2+s^2)^2 >=25 H^4.


Therefore N_u >=(25/4)H^4. On any exact physical subset with H>=H0, tau0<=T0 and Rrel<=U0 (U0 is a magnitude bound, not 115's common-core radical R0),


J_car <=(8/25)*L*T0^6*U0^4/H0^4,
E_psi << B^o(1)*floor((8/25)*L*T0^6*U0^4/H0^4).


If the floor is zero this subset is empty. L is fixed in the packet; it may grow polynomially with B and must not be silently treated as an absolute constant. With L<=B^ell, T0<=B^t, U0<=B^r, H0>=B^h, a sufficient one-twelfth window is


ell+6t+4r-4h <1/12.


This complements the low-H windows of 113/114. It is a scoped bound, not a proof that all physical parameter heights are high enough relative to their cores.


## 3. Height-free two-sided covering criterion


Retain 114's S_sq=M_rel*T with C_u=kappa*T^2 and kappa=sf(C_u). Then S_sq^2 | N_u and S_sq^2 | W_car. Define


V_norm=N_u/S_sq^2,
K_car=W_car/S_sq^2.


Both are positive integers, and exactly


d=sf(V_norm),
V_norm*J_car=K_car.


For Z,Y>=1, endpoints admitting a representation with K_car<=Z*Y satisfy V_norm<=Z or J_car<=Y. If both strict inequalities failed, their product would exceed Z*Y. The first subset has d<=Z and the second has at most floor(Y) cofactor values. Therefore


E_psi(B; K_car<=Z*Y) << B^o(1)*(floor(Z)+floor(Y)).


In particular, for polynomial K0>=1,


E_psi(B; K_car<=K0) << B^o(1)*sqrt(K0),


by choosing Z=Y=sqrt(K0). Hence K_car<=B^(1/6-2delta), delta>0, gives a one-twelfth support deficit B^(1/12-delta+o(1)) without any small-H cutoff. This is a union of two replacement counts; no independence is assumed.


Explicitly


K_car=2*L*tau0^6*Rrel^4*kappa/(M_rel^2*C_u).


Do not infer that a large C_u alone makes K_car small: the actual kappa and all common/nonfresh core factors remain. Because S_sq<=M_rel^2<=Rrel^2, K_car>=2*L*tau0^6. Thus this balanced window cannot automatically cover large common-core magnitude. The direct small-J_car window is more general than the balanced criterion.


## 4. Exact residual receiver and audit plan


For chosen Z_Xi,Z,Y, the union of Xi<=Z_Xi, V_norm<=Z and J_car<=Y has count <<B^o(1)*(Z_Xi+Z+Y). The unresolved complement has simultaneously Xi>Z_Xi, V_norm>Z and J_car>Y, and therefore K_car>ZY. This is a receiver definition, not a distribution theorem. It replaces the overly exclusive requirement to control large Xi by Xi cardinality alone.

## 133. Normalized square-root carrier and packet-supported extreme surplus


M3-T11-116 is now HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS; audit document:

M3-T11-117 — normalized square-root carrier
STATUS=PROVISIONAL / HOSTILE_AUDIT_REQUIRED / EXACT_SAME_MEASURE_SUPPORT_REDUCTION
CARD_117_FILE_ID=1OlV40VEUw1vXI1InNdkkK_CI2ychtmHikbdIb0WcItY


Retain the live psi notation
C_u=kappa*T^2,
M=M_rel,
S_sq=M*T,
Rrel=M*Nrel,
with T|M and Nrel content-supported.


Define
A_car=tau0^3*Rrel^2/(M*T)
=tau0^3*Nrel^2*(M/T).


Because M*T|M^2|Rrel^2, A_car is a positive integer. The 116 carrier satisfies exactly
K_car=W_car/S_sq^2
=2*L*A_car^2.


Equivalently, for Q_S=M^2/C_u,
(M/T)^2=kappa*Q_S.
Hence A_car is the square-root-normalized moving part of K_car.


### 133.1 Fixed A_car fibers


Fix A_car=A. Then K_car=2L A^2 is fixed. Since
V_norm*J_car=K_car,
J_car runs through positive divisors of K_car, only B^o(1) choices in the retained polynomial range. Each J_car fixes
d=sf(2LJ_car).
Audited 113 gives B^o(1) physical endpoints for each fixed d. Therefore


fixed A_car + fixed packet => B^o(1) physical psi endpoints.


If A_A(B) is the number of active A_car values, then


A_A(B) <= E_psi(B) <= B^o(1)*A_A(B).


Thus active A_car support and psi endpoint count have the same polynomial exponent. In particular
E_psi(B;A_car<=X)<<X*B^o(1).


This is a support reduction, not a probability or a global sparsity theorem.


### 133.2 Extreme surplus is packet-supported


At p^lambda||M_rel with the extreme capped conductor c_p=2lambda, corrected 111 gives
min(v_p(N_u),4lambda)=4lambda.


The prime p is fresh relative. Hence p does not occur in tau0 or in the content-supported quotient Nrel=Rrel/M. Audited 115 gives
N_u | 2L*tau0^6*Rrel^4,
so


4lambda <= v_p(N_u) <= 4lambda+v_p(2L).


Therefore any odd extreme excess requires p|2L. Consequently
e_ext | rad(2L).


Do not replace this by e_ext=1. The conclusion is packet support only.


Because Delta_pkt already contains rad(2L), the 115 support relation may be sharpened to


d | Delta_pkt*Xi0,
Xi0=rad(tau0^sharp)*kappa.


Thus extreme surplus is absorbed into the fixed packet factor for support-counting purposes.


### 133.3 Xi0 is contained in the A_car support


If p|kappa, then c_p is odd. Since c_p<=2lambda_p, this forces c_p<2lambda_p and therefore
floor(c_p/2)<lambda_p.
Hence p|M/T.


So
kappa|rad(M/T),
and trivially
rad(tau0^sharp)|rad(tau0).


From
A_car=tau0^3*Nrel^2*(M/T)
we obtain


Xi0 | rad(A_car).


Hence Xi0<=A_car. The former 115 moving support variable is subordinate to the normalized carrier. Large A_car need not imply large Xi0 because even conductor-defect powers in M/T can be invisible to kappa.


### 133.4 New minimal receiver


The next psi theorem target is


PsiNormalizedSquareRootCarrierOneTwelfth:
uniformly per fixed content/coefficient packet, prove
# {active A_car values} << B^(1/12-delta)
for some fixed delta>0,


or an equivalent same-measure correlation theorem.


Because Nrel is supported on the fixed content-prime set, its possible values in the physical polynomial range are B^o(1). Thus the unresolved structural motion is concentrated in
tau0^3*(M_rel/T).


No bound of the required strength is proved here.

One provisional line is corrected:
the literal inequality

is not justified when retained core representations are nonunique.


For a fixed canonical tau, the number of possible A_car values is B^o(1). Indeed, the four-core norm assignment has at most 4^omega(tau) possibilities, and after M_rel is fixed the squarepart parameter T is a divisor of M_rel, giving at most tau(M_rel) possibilities. Hence

# M3-T11-121 — Phi evaluation/root difference: resultant support and denominator firewall


STATUS=PROVED_EXACT_STRUCTURE / WITHIN_SESSION_HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS / NO_GLOBAL_POWER_SAVING

## 1. Exact integral factorization


Write primitive phi parameters r,s, and put
Q0=r^2+s^2,
Q1=r^2-4rs+5s^2,
N=r^2-2rs-s^2,
K=r^2+2rs-s^2,
U=-2s(r-s)N,
V=r^4-6r^3s+12r^2s^2-14rs^3+11s^4.
The physical branch has finite nonzero u=U/V. U^2+V^2=Q0*Q1^3; vartheta=N/Q0.


Define P(z)=V^2 Q_u(z). Exactly
P(z)=(Q0*z-N)*D(z),
where D(z)=d3*z^3+d2*z^2+d1*z+d0, with integer homogeneous coefficients
d3=Q1^3,
d2=N*(r^4+4r^3s-50r^2s^2+100rs^3-51s^4),
d1=4s(r-s)*(3r^4-17r^3s+35r^2s^2-41rs^3+32s^4),
d0=4s^2(r-s)^2*N.
The cubic D is not the conductor C_u. Its monic version is D/Q1^3.


The exact linear/cubic resultant is
Res_z(Q0*z-N,D(z))=2*Q1^2*N*K^3.
Equivalently,
Q0^3*D(N/Q0)=2*Q1^2*N*K^3.
For a nonzero rational parameter pair, Q0,Q1>0 and N,K are nonzero: their roots in r/s involve sqrt(2), and the infinity value is nonzero. Thus the factors never share a rational root here.


## 2. Integer evaluation support theorem


Let the actual evaluation point be z_phys=a/b=S/2 in lowest terms, b>0 and gcd(a,b)=1. These a,b are evaluation numerator/denominator, not the reduced numerator/denominator of u.
Set
L=Q0*a-N*b,
D_h=d3*a^3+d2*a^2*b+d1*a*b^2+d0*b^3.
The physical negative-square norm gives
L*D_h/(Q0*Q1^3*b^4)=-w^2,
so L*D_h=-Q0*Q1^3*(b^2*w)^2 with b^2*w rational.
Both factors are nonzero on the retained distinct-root physical locus. In particular L is not forced to vanish.


Let delta be the signed squarefree integer representative of L: L=delta*y^2 with y a positive integer. Then
rad(|delta|) divides rad(2*Q0*Q1*N*K).


Proof: take p not dividing 2Q0Q1NK. If p divides b, Q0*a is a unit modulo p, so p does not divide L. Otherwise a/b is defined modulo p. If both L and D_h vanished modulo p, N/Q0 would be a root of D modulo p, contradicting the nonzero resultant. Hence p|L implies p does not divide D_h. The displayed negative-square relation then forces v_p(L) even. This proves the support statement for all such primes, without a local-probability assumption. Bad primes are retained rather than divided away.


With H=max(|r|,|s|)>=1,
|delta|<=|2Q0Q1NK|<=640H^8.
For each fixed parameter pair there are at most 2^(omega(2Q0Q1NK)+1) signed delta labels; in the retained polynomial physical height range this is B^o(1). This is a support theorem, not a count of moving parameter pairs or a new endpoint saving.


## 3. Actual rational difference keeps the denominator


The true difference is
z_phys-vartheta=L/(Q0*b).
In Q^*/Q^{*2}, exactly
[z_phys-vartheta]=[delta*Q0*b].
Consequently the integer delta support theorem does NOT bound the rational linear etale component solely by 2Q0Q1NK. Odd-valuation primes of the moving evaluation denominator b can enter that component. They cannot be silently discarded or replaced by the phi parameter height.


For clarity, fixed (r,s) already fixes u and audited 036 already supplies B^o(1) physical endpoints. The B^o(1) number of delta labels at fixed (r,s) is therefore not a second saving. A fixed delta across varying (r,s) has no uniform B^o(1) endpoint theorem here.


## 4. Interior allocation consistency check


For a relative-fresh interior p^lambda, 0<c_p<2lambda, audited 099/100 and 106 give v_p(b)=k=2lambda-c_p, v_p(a)=0, and norm depth n=2lambda+c_p.
On Q0 allocation, v_p(Q0)=n>k and N is a unit, hence v_p(L)=k. Thus v_p(delta) mod 2=c_p mod 2. The rational difference has valuation k-n-k=-n, agreeing with the canonical negative-valuation root comparison.
On Q1 allocation, Q0,N are units and b is p-divisible, hence L is a unit. Thus p does not divide delta. But the rational difference has valuation -k, with parity c_p. The denominator restores exactly the local class that would be lost by using delta alone.
These checks recover the old local tuple; neither allocation supplies independent rarity. No statement is made here about endpoint occupancy at these primes, extreme-only support, or the withdrawn 120 valuation equalities.


## 5. Continuation and credit boundary


The valid global correlation problem now has explicit integral coordinates:
L=delta*y^2,
L*D_h=-Q0*Q1^3*(b^2*w)^2,
supp(delta) subset supp(2Q0Q1NK),
actual linear class=[delta Q0 b].
A useful next theorem must control moving (r,s), delta and evaluation denominator b jointly on the same physical R<=B measure, or produce a genuine cross-invariant constraint not implied by the existing norm and primewise tuple. In particular it must cover the full residual outside 119's height/conductor windows, including high-height shells. A mere sum over divisor-many delta values per fixed parameter adds no exponent credit.

## M3-T11-122 — Phi fresh difference squareclass collapse and twist-support firewall

+B_z^2*Q1*B8*L

## 1. Integral model and exact scalar correction


Put N=a^2+b^2, Delta0=2b^2-25a^2, T0=a^2+2b^2 and
F(X)=N X^4-8ab X^3+(11a^2-b^2)X^2+6ab X-a^2.
Then F=b^2 Q_u and its monic version F/N defines K_u on the S4 complement.


Let theta be its root and alpha=N theta. The integral monic polynomial of alpha is
G(X)=N^3 F(X/N)
=X^4-8abX^3+N(11a^2-b^2)X^2+6abN^2X-a^2N^3.


Exact discriminants:
disc(F)=16a^2 N^2 Delta0^3,
disc(G)=16a^2 N^8 Delta0^3.
Delta0!=0 for nonzero rational u, since 25(a/b)^2=2 has no rational solution.
The order Z[alpha] need not be maximal. Its index has no prime outside disc(G), which is all that the proof needs; do not equate order and field discriminants.


Write the actual physical z=S/2=m/n in lowest terms, n>0. Define
beta=N m-n alpha=N n(z-theta).
It is an algebraic integer and is nonzero since the physical norm is nonzero on the retained distinct-root locus.


For F_h(m,n)=N m^4-8abm^3n+(11a^2-b^2)m^2n^2+6abmn^3-a^2n^4,
Norm(beta)=N^3 F_h(m,n).
Audited105 gives F(z)/N=-w^2 for a nonzero rational w. Hence
Norm(beta)=-(N^2 n^2 w)^2.


The exact original squareclass is
[z-theta]=[N n beta] in K_u^*/K_u^{*2}.
This scalar correction is essential. beta is NOT generally the original class. The actual evaluation denominator has been removed from the normalized packet, not silently removed from the physical descent class.


## 2. Denominator-free finite-prime support theorem


Let S_u be the set of rational primes dividing 2aNDelta0, and S_K the prime ideals of O_K above S_u. Define
K(S_K,2)={ [c] in K^*/K^{*2}: v_P(c) is even for all P outside S_K }.


For every retained physical point,
[beta] belongs to K(S_K,2).


Proof: take p not in S_u. The order Z[alpha] is maximal and etale at p, N is a p-unit, and G mod p is squarefree.
If p divides n, primitiveness makes m a p-unit; beta=N m-n alpha is a unit at every prime above p.
If p does not divide n, beta can vanish only where alpha has residue N m/n in F_p. Squarefreeness means at most one prime ideal divides beta, and that prime has residue degree one. The p-valuation of Norm(beta) is therefore exactly its ideal valuation there. The norm is a negative rational square, so this valuation is even. All other valuations are zero.
This proves the statement, including primes in the moving evaluation denominator n. It is an ideal squareclass theorem, not an assertion that beta itself is an S-unit or a square.


At these odd good primes, the corresponding quadratic extension K(sqrt(beta))/K is unramified. Archimedean signs are retained; no positivity or full local Selmer condition is inferred.


## 3. Universal negative-square norm witness


Define the nonzero algebraic integer
gamma=alpha(aN-b alpha).


Exactly,
Norm(alpha)=-a^2 N^3,
Norm(aN-b alpha)=a^2 N^3 T0^2,
Norm(gamma)=-(a^2 N^3 T0)^2.


The second identity is the evaluation F(a/b)=a^2 T0^2/b^4. All quantities in the square are nonzero for a!=0, b>0.


Furthermore [gamma] belongs to K(S_K,2), with NO enlargement by primes of b or T0.
Proof: outside S_u, alpha is a unit by its norm. If p divides b, aN-b alpha is a unit everywhere. If p does not divide b, only the one degree-one prime with alpha=aN/b mod p can divide the second factor, and its norm valuation is even because Norm(aN-b alpha)=a^2N^3T0^2. The same good-order argument as Section2 applies.


Therefore the coarse supported norm fiber
H_u^-={c in K(S_K,2): [Norm(c)]=[-1]}
is NONEMPTY for every rational u on the retained S4 complement:
[gamma] belongs to H_u^-.


This is stronger than merely noting that physical points have norm [-1]. No physical point was used to construct gamma. Screening u by emptiness of this particular coarse supported norm fiber can never remove a u.


Important boundary: H_u^- is NOT the full genus-2 fake Selmer set, NOT the everywhere locally soluble descent image, and NOT the realized physical point image. gamma need not lift to any physical point or any full genus-2 two-cover. Smaller/local-compatible sets can still be empty. No Perfect Cuboid existence is inferred.


## 4. The remaining object is a norm-kernel coset


Let
V_u=ker(Norm: K(S_K,2) -> Q^*/Q^{*2}).
Then exactly H_u^-=[gamma] V_u.


For a physical point set
xi=beta/gamma.
It satisfies [xi] in V_u, and the original class is recovered as
[z-theta]=[N n gamma xi].


This preserves genuinely non-norm information instead of taking its norm and declaring it trivial. Neither xi nor V_u is proved trivial or fixed. The audited106/107 primewise tuple remains consumed; this construction gives no additional local selector at those primes.


## 5. Explicit finite-label bound and its missing counting adapter


There is the standard exact sequence
1 -> O_{K,S_K}^*/O_{K,S_K}^{*2}
  -> K(S_K,2)
  -> Cl(O_{K,S_K})[2]
  -> 1.
The map sends a class with even valuations outside S_K to the ideal square root class. Surjectivity follows because a 2-torsion ideal class has a square principal ideal in the localized ring.


Dirichlet gives |O_{K,S_K}^*/O_{K,S_K}^{*2}|=2^(r1+r2+|S_K|), and degree4 gives r1+r2<=4, |S_K|<=4|S_u|.
The localized class group is a quotient of Cl(K); for a finite abelian group, a quotient has no larger F2 dimension modulo2, so
|Cl(O_{K,S_K})[2]|<=|Cl(K)[2]|.
Consequently
|V_u|=|H_u^-| <= |K(S_K,2)|
<=2^(4+4 omega(|2aNDelta0|)) |Cl(K_u)[2]|.


No class groups were computed or assumed odd. No uniform B^o(1) bound for this moving quartic family is proved here.
For H=max(|a|,b), |2aNDelta0|<=100H^5 and |disc(K_u)|<=|disc(G)|<=64,000,000H^24. In a retained polynomial physical height range the elementary 2^omega factor is B^o(1); the class-group factor must remain.


Even an additional small-class-group theorem would only give few labels PER u. Audited036 already gives B^o(1) physical endpoints per fixed u. It would not reduce the number of moving realized u values, and labels in different K_u cannot be identified without an exact cross-field adapter. No bound on occupied u, no support-cardinality contraction and no fixed-power endpoint saving follows from this finite-label count.

## 1. Exact reduced cofactor adapter
